pack: Operation: The Labyrinth – Bayu Beach Experience Pack V1

experiences.title: The Paris Fragment
experiences.story: A torn image from the vessel’s atlas may identify the island’s former owners.
experiences.task: Search public venue areas. When the match is certain, take a team selfie with the object visible behind you. Do not touch or move it.
experiences.evidence: One photo: all team members plus the matching object clearly visible.
experiences.crop_note: Cropped image only: stone arch, handwritten script and a small French postal mark.
experiences.transmission:
SIGNAL RESTORED

Commander...

Our archive has recovered references to an object codenamed
"The Paris Fragment."

Expedition Alpha believed this object contained the first surviving clue explaining why previous expeditions disappeared.

Recover visual confirmation.
experiences.ai_response:
Archive comparison complete.

Match Confidence: 96%

Journal Fragment 01 recovered.

Expedition Alpha archive partially restored.

+100 Intelligence Credits

Continue exploring.

experiences.title: Six Across
experiences.story: The lift shaft is sealed. Its old capacity plate contains the first number key.
experiences.task: Answer: Two identical lifts each begin empty. Eleven survivors enter, distributed legally. What two possible occupancies differ by exactly one? Give the pair in ascending order.
experiences.evidence: Text: “5 and 6,” plus a photo of the capacity sign.
experiences.transmission:
NUMBER KEY REQUIRED

Commander...

A sealed shaft has retained one operational constraint: six persons per chamber.

Use the surviving capacity plate to resolve the eleven-survivor transfer code.

Read quickly. Solve away from the doors.

experiences.title: Two Arrows, One Escape
experiences.story: Two surviving signs point in different ways: one toward the beach, one toward the main entrance.
experiences.task: Give a three-sentence explanation using position, facing direction and destination. Include one fact that would need checking.
experiences.evidence: Text answer; two supporting photos are encouraged.
experiences.crop_note: Reference view of the real Beach arrow; compare with the red 60 m Main Entrance arrow on site.
experiences.transmission:
ROUTE CONFLICT DETECTED

Commander...

Two surviving arrows appear to disagree. One indicates the beach; the other, a main entrance sixty metres away.

Determine how both directions can remain true from their own positions.

Do not invent a compass bearing.

Viewpoint, facing direction and destination reasoning verified.

experiences.title: Ink Mountain Count

experiences.task: Choose one feature—red seals, distinct boats, or isolated peak groups. State the count, define what qualified, and identify one ambiguous case.
experiences.evidence: Text answer plus a straight-on photo of the painting.
experiences.crop_note: Straight-on full view of the black-ink landscape.

INNER LOCK ANALYSIS

Commander...

The mountain image contains no single obvious number. The lock accepts a count only when its rule can be repeated.

Define the feature first. Count second. Record the ambiguity.

experiences.title: Twenty Seconds of Island
experiences.story: The Labyrinth cannot see the wind, but it can hear where the island is alive.
experiences.task: Record 20 seconds: point silently toward each sound as it occurs. At the end, speak exactly three labels for the strongest sound sources.
experiences.evidence: One 20–25 second video; no added music or effects.
experiences.crop_note: Approved mature shade-tree location on the beachfront lawn.
experiences.transmission:
AMBIENT CHANNEL OPEN

Commander...

The Labyrinth cannot see the island’s movement, but it can receive its sound.

Choose the approved shaded position. Listen before recording. Point silently, then name exactly three sources.

Keep clear of exposed roots.
